answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The echo is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the fable. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the lagoon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
